summary.title: Trade Ware + VanVleet for Jamal Murray (Yeet)
summary.headline: 2-for-1 consolidation: Kel'el Ware + Fred VanVleet to Yeet (slot 6) for Jamal Murray, then refill the open roster spot from free agency.
summary.verdict: Pursue only if we can land Julian Champagnie (best FA; on waivers until Oct 22) to fill the open roster spot; main risk Murray's health.

metrics.label: Share of the title gain from Denver's 4-game weeks 19-20
metrics.note: Murray shares Jokić's (Denver) schedule; the fantasy playoff weeks are where it pays

risks: Murray's health: with a 50-game prior (an assumption, not fitted) the title gain shrinks to +4.1 pp and P(playoffs) turns negative (−2.2 pp).
The refill matters: if Champagnie is claimed first (waivers clear Oct 22) and we end up with Aldama, P(playoffs) falls slightly (−0.5 to −2.0 pp) while P(title) still rises.
About half the title gain rests on Denver's 4-game weeks 19-20 (schedule, not player quality).
± values are Monte Carlo SEs only; they exclude projection and model error, and the simulator is optimistic for our team (opponents never manage their rosters).
Yahoo trades go through commissioner review with a 2-day veto window, and the follow-up free-agent add is a separate move that also needs your yes.
